User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user's profile, storing non-sensitive information. The document ID is the user's auth UID.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

SoundProfile.title: SoundProfile
SoundProfile.description: Represents a saved sound profile with specific frequency, volume, waveform, and phase settings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sound profile.

leftFreq.description: Frequency for the left ear (in Hz).

rightFreq.description: Frequency for the right ear (in Hz).

leftVol.description: Volume for the left ear (as a percentage).

rightVol.description: Volume for the right ear (as a percentage).

waveType.description: Waveform type (e.g., sine, square, sawtooth, triangle).

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the profile was created.

leftPhaseInverted.description: Whether the left channel's phase is inverted.

rightPhaseInverted.description: Whether the right channel's phase is inverted.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. The document ID '{userId}' is the Firebase Auth UID.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Auth user's unique ID.

definition.description: Stores sound profiles created by a user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Auth user's unique ID.

params.name: soundProfileId
params.description: The unique identifier for the sound profile (UUID).

firestore.reasoning: The user profile is stored in a top-level `users` collection with the document ID matching the user's authentication UID. This allows for direct and efficient lookups. Sound profiles are stored in a subcollection under each user's document, naturally associating the data with its owner and simplifying security rules.
